_comment: Community profile — runners resuming from a significant spell. Useful for identifying horses that may be overlooked by the market after a long absence. Copy the profile object you want into profiles.json to activate it.

profiles.name: Resuming from 90+ day layoff
profiles._comment: Broader first-up filter — catches horses back from a meaningful rest without requiring an extreme layoff.

profiles.name: Resuming from 300+ day layoff
